item.title: FitTrack Ad From Supplied Screenshots

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen 16:9 ad for FitTrack using both screenshots. Show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name. Clean, energetic, with an upbeat instrumental beat and no voiceover. Other copy is your call.

item.tests: Uses supplied app screenshots faithfully in a finished landscape ad rather than inventing replacement screens.

answer_sheet.Brand and source images: FitTrack; use app-home.png followed by app-workout.png.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Clean and energetic; other design choices are your call.
answer_sheet.On-screen wording: End with FitTrack; other copy is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
The supplied FitTrack home screenshot appears before the supplied workout screenshot.
Both screenshots remain recognizable and readable, without invented replacement UI.
An upbeat instrumental track is audible, with no voiceover.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a clean, energetic 10-second widescreen 16:9 fitness app advertisement for FitTrack using BOTH supplied screenshot references prominently and in this exact order. These are actual app UI screenshots: preserve their typography, layout, colors and content faithfully rather than inventing another UI. Fit each full portrait screenshot inside a crisp smartphone-shaped presentation centered within the widescreen composition with generous white negative space. Timeline: 0.0–4.0 seconds show @home, the blue-header FitTrack home screen, first. Smooth gentle push-in with subtle blue motion accents and large separate headline 'Your day. In motion.' 4.0–8.0 seconds transition with a quick clean lateral slide to @workout, the green-header workout screen. Display it clearly with subtle green motion accents and separate headline 'Make every rep count.' 8.0–10.0 seconds finish on a minimal, confident brand title card with the exact app name 'FitTrack' large and centered, blue and green accents, and small tagline 'Track. Train. Thrive.' Hold final app name legibly through the end. Premium minimal flat motion-graphics design, bright white background, blue and green palette drawn from the screenshots, purposeful rhythmic transitions, no people, no additional app screens. Soundtrack: upbeat instrumental electronic fitness beat with punchy drums, warm bass and bright synths, rhythmic throughout with a polished final hit. Absolutely no voiceover, no speech, no singing, no vocals.
